property_summary: After any successful fallback call, a subsequent call is possible (i.e., does not revert) given a strictly increased block.timestamp; the reference allows it but the buggy version always reverts on the second attempt because it requires the impossible block.timestamp < pastBlockTime.
change_summary: Replace require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) with require(block.timestamp < pastBlockTime), which would permanently lock the fallback after the first call because pastBlockTime can never be greater than current time.
